_comment: Surround locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is. Do NOT translate the move/direction tokens the player types ([up], [down], [left], [right], w, s, a, d) or the ASCII board rendered into {board}.

_slots.{num_players}: Number of players in the match
_slots.{board}: The rendered ASCII grid; keep neutral, never translate its characters
_slots.{groups}: Neutral ranking data (a list of player-id groups, best to worst); do not translate

player_prompt.intro:
{num_players}-Dɔwɔla si wɔ na {width}x{height} grid.
Efe dɔwɔla {player_id}. Nya siwo menya: '[up]' '[down]' '[left]' '[right]' alɔga wɔ 'w/s/a/d'.
Nusɔsrɔ si: ku nyɔnuwo hɛ. Trails katɛ ɖo; wɔ ɖo ɖi ɖo; anyi siwo wɔ ɖo ku sia.

board.after_moves: Ne woƒo agba ɖeka le ɣeyiɣi ma ke me la, kpea: {board}

game_action.invalid_death: Fefewɔla {player_id} ku le asitɔtrɔ madzemadze ta.

outcome.survived_win: Fefewɔla {player_id} tsi agbe; ame susɔeawo katã dze anyi.
outcome.all_crashed: Amesiwo katã nɔ fefe ma wɔm la dze anyi le ɣeyiɣi ɖeka me.
outcome.turn_limit: Ne wotrɔa asi le eŋu wòde akpa aɖe dzi la, amesi tsi agbe didi wu lae ɖu.
